pages.text: $(l)Purpose$()$pRuns Basic, Scientific and Atomic lanes in one validated hollow shell. The lanes share output storage, rather than maintaining three independent output inventories.$p$(l)Set up and operate$()$p1. Build the controller-relative shell described in Multiblocks.$p2. Put Basic inputs in positions 1–2, Scientific in 3–4, Atomic in 5–7.$p3. Supply FE and keep shared outputs clear.$p4. Wait for the scheduled structure check after correcting a missing wall.$p$(l)When it does not run$()$pAn occupied interior, wrong corner material, unloaded shell position or blocked shared output can stop all lanes.$pRead the active server settings below before copying default costs from another installation. For special slot roles, use the machine screen labels. Settings reporting does not inspect or mutate a placed machine.$pActual server settings: live server values are available in the native or master Foundations reader.$pCrafting / obtaining this machine: live recipe details are available in the native or master Foundations reader.$p$(l:foundations_calculator:multiblocks/dynamic)Exact default shell layers$()
